svg.title: Pero Paper: add, read, ask, and review
svg.desc: Simplified editorial UI schematic based on user-supplied library and selected-PDF/shared-Chat screenshots reviewed on 2026-11-07, whose application revision is unknown. Older controlled fixture captures inform the import and reader layout. Paper source at c12c2ab0 supplements the research-record and report state not shown in those screenshots. The global workbench sidebar is abbreviated, but remains separate from the Paper tab and Paper internal navigation. The internal menu follows the screenshot-visible Library, Discover, Research results, Papers, Reading, To read, and Collections hierarchy; newer source-only controls are intentionally omitted. Add papers opens Search, PDF, Import text, and Research URL tabs. Reader modes, page navigation, zoom, clock, and Ask AI occupy one header row. Selection actions sit immediately below it. The local-PDF example has no HTTPS Source target; TeX remains an unselected tab, which does not mean TeX source is available. The shared Host Chat has Artifacts, Agent/workspace selection, context chips, and a user-sent composer; Paper does not own a separate chat. Research record contains date-grouped questions and statuses, selected detail, citations, and Continue from here. Paper titles, collections, counts, page numbers, questions, dates, and document lines are illustrative placeholders, not user data or research findings. Gold marks editorial emphasis, not verification. No live GUI, fixed-version, scientific-quality, native-package, or production acceptance is claimed.
